program: PC Part Performance, console evidence correction
review: Source evidence checked; owner editorial publication review pending
scope: All 45 existing game-library console records. Registry performs no network calls or performance estimates.
policy: Source check date is not a measurement date. Historical target/cap and test-edition scope remains visible.
Exact game and system keys only. No PS5-to-Pro, Switch-to-Switch-2 or edition fallback.
An output refresh rate is not rendered FPS. Unknown FPS and internal pixel counts stay null.
Narrative review observations are labeled separately from instrumented original analysis and manufacturer targets.
Grouped labels do not prove all submodels were tested; appliesTo constrains exact-model coverage.
Publications are linked and paraphrased. No benchmark dataset, images or videos are copied; redistribution rights are not established.
Legacy strings below are audit material only. They must never become a fallback public payload.
A failed, blocked, unavailable or incomplete research fetch is an evidence limitation, not proof that a public page is broken.

primaryChartInspection.inspection: Chart rendered locally at 1800 pixels and visually inspected; PDF image pages are not reliable text-extraction evidence.

sources.title: Fortnite next-generation console modes, v15.10 update
sources.findings: PS5 and Series X: 4K/60; 120 mode at maximum 1440p. Series S: maximum 1200p/60, or 1080p/120. This December 2020 update does not mention PS5 Pro.

sources.title: Fortnite Switch resolution update
sources.findings: Documents expected dynamic resolution of 1560 × 880 docked and 1170 × 660 handheld, but no numerical frame rate.

sources.title: Fortnite comes to Nintendo Switch 2
sources.findings: Switch 2 publication specifies 60 FPS, 2176 × 1224 docked and 1600 × 900 handheld.

sources.title: Rendering God of War Ragnarök, GDC 2023
sources.findings: Graphics-mode chart on PDF page 70 distinguishes PS4, PS4 Pro and PS5 targets. PS4 Pro performance is unlocked from a 30 FPS base, not a 60 FPS target.

sources.title: God of War Ragnarök patch notes v06.00
sources.findings: PS5 Pro Enhanced uses favour-quality features at 60 FPS. HFR unlocks with VRR; PSSR is optional. Exact pixel dimensions and measured averages are not supplied.

sources.title: Spider-Man Remastered graphics modes
sources.findings: PS5 fidelity targets 30 FPS; performance targets 60 FPS. Describes temporal 4K from different base resolutions.

sources.title: Miles Morales PS5 graphics modes
sources.findings: Explicit PS5 section gives fidelity 30 FPS and performance 60 FPS, with temporal 4K from different base resolutions.

sources.title: VRR support
sources.findings: Compatible 120 Hz displays, VRR and game updates can unlock frame rates. This does not establish a fixed higher average.

sources.title: Spider-Man 2 technical performance review
sources.findings: Original technical analysis documents fidelity 30, performance 60, and fidelity 40 on 120 Hz displays. Reported modes are caps/targets, not a cross-scene average or 1% low.

sources.title: VALORANT console guide
sources.findings: Confirms console platforms; inspected guide does not establish numerical FPS or internal resolution.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto V available on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
sources.findings: Native PS5/Series X edition: fidelity native 4K with ray tracing targets 30; performance upscaled 4K targets 60; performance RT upscaled 4K with ray tracing targets 60.

sources.title: GTA V Xbox One versus PlayStation 4 graphics comparison
sources.findings: Original launch-build analysis reports native 1080p and a 30 FPS target with busy-scene drops. It does not test the later Xbox One S.

sources.title: Monster Hunter Wilds ready for the hunt on February 28
sources.findings: Separate PS5 and PS5 Pro modes target 30, 40 or 60 FPS; balanced requires a 120 Hz display. Pro modes use PSSR. Exact internal pixel counts are absent.

sources.title: Welcome to Forza Horizon 5
sources.findings: Series X quality is 4K/30, Series S quality is 1080p/30. Both have a 60 FPS performance option; this source does not give its exact resolution or old-console numerical targets.

sources.title: Sea of Thieves on Xbox Series X and S
sources.findings: Developer announcement specifies Series X 4K/60 and Series S 1080p/60.
sources.accessNote: Equivalent official locale publication inspected; English URL returned access failure in research tool.

sources.title: Sea of Thieves release notes 2.0.21
sources.findings: Documents a Series X 120 Hz performance mode at 1080p and display/HDR conditions. Hz is an output refresh mode; this registry does not convert it into measured or targeted FPS.

sources.title: Five Bethesda titles get FPS Boost
sources.findings: Skyrim Special Edition backward-compatible FPS Boost is described as nearly 60 FPS on Series X|S. No exact per-system resolution is given; this is distinct from the later native edition.

sources.title: War Thunder FAQ
sources.findings: FAQ specifies optimized Series X at 4K/60 FPS and Series S at 1440p/60 FPS. These are publisher claims, not site measurements.

sources.title: Breath of the Wild Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

sources.title: Breath of the Wild Nintendo Switch edition

sources.title: Ask the Developer volume 18: Mario Kart World, chapter 1
sources.findings: Programming director discusses maintaining the series 60 FPS goal in this Switch 2 project. This does not establish split-screen performance or exact resolutions.

sources.title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe review

sources.title: Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2

sources.title: Technical check: Super Mario Galaxy 1+2
sources.findings: Author reports both 2025 remasters at 60 FPS on Switch and Switch 2, docked/handheld, with occasional transition stutters. No instrumented dataset, patch or sample count is supplied; Switch Lite is not independently tested.

sources.title: Iwata Asks: Super Mario Galaxy, developers chapter 5
sources.findings: Programmer describes the original Wii game running at 60 FPS. This is a developer claim for the Wii edition, not evidence from the later remaster.

sources.title: Iwata Asks: Super Mario Galaxy 2, chapter 6
sources.findings: Programmer explicitly describes the original Wii game at 60 FPS. No pixel resolution or independent test average is supplied.

sources.title: Nintendo Switch play modes
sources.findings: Switch Lite has no TV mode. Docked observations cannot be presented as Switch Lite measurements.

sources.title: Minecraft for Nintendo Switch 2 preorder announcement
sources.findings: Regional announcement describes an upcoming native Switch 2 release; it does not verify FPS for either that release or backward compatibility.
